percentage-calculator.title: Online percentage calculator — CalcHub
percentage-calculator.name: Percentage calculator
percentage-calculator.description: Free percentage calculator: find a percentage of a number, what percent one number is of another, percentage change, and increase or decrease a number by a percentage.
percentage-calculator.intro: Choose a calculation type and enter two numbers: the result appears instantly. Your data is not sent to any server.

percentOf.name: Percentage of a number
percentOf.explain: To find a percentage of a number, multiply the number by the percentage and divide by 100.

whatPercent.name: What percent one number is of another
whatPercent.explain: Divide the part by the whole and multiply by 100.

change.name: Percentage change between two numbers
change.explain: Subtract the starting value from the new value, divide by the absolute value of the starting value and multiply by 100. A positive result is an increase, a negative one is a decrease.

increase.name: Increase a number by a percentage

decrease.name: Decrease a number by a percentage

percentage-calculator.faq1q: How do I calculate a percentage of a number?
percentage-calculator.faq1a: Multiply the number by the percentage and divide by 100. For example, 15% of 200: 200 × 15 ÷ 100 = 30.
percentage-calculator.faq2q: What is the difference between a 10% increase and a 10 percentage point increase?
percentage-calculator.faq2a: A 10% increase changes a value relative to itself: 50 becomes 55. Percentage points are the difference between two percentages: going from 5% to 15% is 10 percentage points, but relative to the starting value it is a 200% increase.
percentage-calculator.faq3q: Why doesn’t a number return to the original after decreasing and then increasing by the same percentage?
percentage-calculator.faq3a: Because the second percentage is calculated from the new number. Decrease 100 by 20% and you get 80; increase 80 by 20% and you get 96, not 100.

discount-calculator.title: Online discount calculator — CalcHub
discount-calculator.name: Discount calculator
discount-calculator.description: Free discount calculator: find the price after discount and the amount you save from the original price and discount percentage.
discount-calculator.intro: Enter the original price and the discount percentage to see the final price and how much you save.
discount-calculator.keywords: discount sale offer price after discount знижка rabatt
discount-calculator.howItWorks: The discount amount is a percentage of the original price. Subtracting it from the price gives the final cost. You can also do it in one step: price × (1 − discount ÷ 100).
discount-calculator.faq1q: How do I calculate a price after a discount?
discount-calculator.faq1a: Multiply the price by (1 − discount ÷ 100). For example, 1200 with a 25% discount: 1200 × 0.75 = 900.
discount-calculator.faq2q: How do I find the discount percentage from an old and a new price?
discount-calculator.faq2a: Subtract the new price from the old one, divide by the old price and multiply by 100. The “Percentage change” mode in the percentage calculator does this for you.

vat-calculator.title: Online VAT calculator — CalcHub
vat-calculator.name: VAT calculator
vat-calculator.description: Free VAT calculator: add VAT to a net amount or extract the VAT from an amount that already includes it.
vat-calculator.intro: Choose what to calculate, enter the amount and the VAT rate to see the VAT, the net amount and the gross amount.
vat-calculator.keywords: vat tax value added tax moms пдв sales tax
vat-calculator.howItWorks: To add VAT, multiply the net amount by the rate and divide by 100: that is the VAT. To extract VAT from a gross amount, divide it by (1 + rate ÷ 100) to get the net amount; the difference is the VAT.
vat-calculator.example: Net 1000 at 20%: VAT = 200, total 1200. In reverse: from 1200 including VAT, 1000 is the net amount.
vat-calculator.faq1q: How do I add VAT to a price?
vat-calculator.faq1a: Multiply the net price by (1 + rate ÷ 100). At a 20% rate, 1000 becomes 1200.
vat-calculator.faq2q: How do I extract VAT from an amount that already includes it?
vat-calculator.faq2a: Do not take the rate of the gross amount: that overstates the VAT. Divide the amount by (1 + rate ÷ 100) to get the net price, then subtract it from the amount. For example, 1200 ÷ 1.2 = 1000, so the VAT is 200.

area-calculator.title: Online area calculator — CalcHub
area-calculator.name: Area calculator
area-calculator.description: Free area calculator: work out the area of a rectangle, triangle or circle in metres, centimetres, millimetres or feet.
area-calculator.intro: Choose a shape and a unit, enter the dimensions and the area is calculated instantly.
area-calculator.keywords: area square meters square feet rectangle triangle circle площа
area-calculator.howItWorks: The area depends on the shape: for a rectangle it is length × width, for a triangle base × height ÷ 2, and for a circle π × radius². The result is given in square units of the length unit you chose.
area-calculator.faq1q: How do I calculate the area of a room?
area-calculator.faq1a: If the room is rectangular, multiply the length by the width. For an irregular room, split it into simple shapes, find the area of each and add them together.
area-calculator.faq2q: How many square centimetres are in a square metre?
area-calculator.faq2a: 10,000. Since 1 m = 100 cm and area is the product of two lengths: 100 × 100 = 10,000.

volume-calculator.title: Online volume calculator — CalcHub
volume-calculator.name: Volume calculator
volume-calculator.description: Free volume calculator: work out the volume of a box, cylinder or sphere and see the result in litres right away.
volume-calculator.intro: Choose a shape and a unit, enter the dimensions and see the volume in cubic units and in litres.
volume-calculator.keywords: volume cubic meters litres liters box cylinder sphere об’єм
volume-calculator.howItWorks: The volume of a box is length × width × height, of a cylinder π × radius² × height, and of a sphere 4/3 × π × radius³. One cubic metre equals 1,000 litres.
volume-calculator.faq1q: How many litres are in a cubic metre?
volume-calculator.faq1a: 1,000 litres. A cubic metre is a cube with 1 m sides, which is 100 × 100 × 100 cm = 1,000,000 cm³, and a litre is 1,000 cm³.
volume-calculator.faq2q: How do I calculate the volume of a cylinder?
volume-calculator.faq2a: Multiply the base area (π × radius²) by the height. For example, radius 0.5 m and height 2 m: 3.1416 × 0.25 × 2 ≈ 1.571 m³.
